title: EVASÃO-ZERO - Dashboard Preditivo de Evasão Estudantil
summary: A student-dropout risk prediction system for Brazilian Federal Institutes (IFMS), combining a Random Forest model with a Streamlit dashboard trained on INEP educational census data. A utility script uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic student response data, evaluated with SDV's quality report.
